goal: prove that a real archive exported by the pre-rename build still imports into Traceweave
steps: installed org.traceform.agentos 0.6.14 (old package) next to the new app
created one synthetic memory (MigrationCanaryPreference) through its UI
exported it with the app's encrypted export to Downloads (agent-os-memory-20261031.taos, 416 bytes)
pulled the archive and kept it as agent_os/tests/data/legacy-0.6.14-memory.taos
installed the new build with ArchiveCompat and imported the same archive
result: the new app accepted the legacy archive, showed the review step, imported it, and the memory MigrationCanaryPreference is visible in the vault
bug_found_on_the_way: the import passphrase dialog used a horizontal LinearLayout, so the passphrase field had zero width and a user could not type anything; fixed by setting the holder to VERTICAL
